meta.methodology: Stocks discussed AS AN OPPORTUNITY (buy pitches, upgrades, target raises, 'undervalued / top pick' features) across financial and public sources in the window. Score = verified analyst action 3 pts per firm — an upgrade, a target raise at a bullish rating, or a bullish initiation (reiterations at unchanged targets and raises at neutral ratings do not count); major-outlet opportunity feature or fund-manager pitch 2 pts per outlet; trending-list appearance 1 pt per list; verified bullish social discussion 1 pt per platform, capped at 2. A name needs at least 2 distinct sources to be listed. CORRECTED EDITION (Oct 27): social evidence is snippet-based — public posts and roundups readable via search across StockTwits, Instagram, Facebook, Threads and Reddit — and counts only clearly bullish, opportunity-framed discussion; names whose social discussion is genuinely divided score no social points, templated pump posts are excluded, and creator or paid-club material counts only when corroborated. This edition also folds in the analyst actions of Oct 26–27 that the first edition could not verify in time.
meta.correction_note: Corrected edition published Oct 27, 2026: adds the snippet-based social lane and the verified Oct 26–27 analyst actions. 8 names added (MU, NBIS, ZS, WDAY, HOOD, PLTR, PYPL, VLO), none removed; TSLA moves to #1, AVGO to #8. The first edition (31 names, social unscored) is superseded.
